It has been updated for the 2024-2025 formula to target the Omicron variant KP.2 strain of SARS-CoV-2. The vaccine is developed by Moderna, in collaboration with the U.S. National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases and the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority.
